title: Present Perfect
explanation: Use have/has + past participle for experiences (I have visited Turkey), recent results (She has lost her keys), and unfinished time periods (I have worked here for three years). Use the past simple instead when the time is finished and specific: I visited Turkey in 2019.
explanationPersian: حال کامل با have/has و اسم مفعول ساخته می‌شود و برای تجربه‌ها، نتایج اخیر و بازه‌های زمانی ناتمام به کار می‌رود. اگر زمان مشخص و تمام‌شده باشد (مثلاً in 2019) از گذشته ساده استفاده کنید.

examples.english: She has just finished the report.
examples.persian: او همین الان گزارش را تمام کرده است.

examples.english: Have you ever been to Istanbul?
I saw that film last week.
examples.persian: آن فیلم را هفته پیش دیدم.
examples.note: finished time → past simple, NOT present perfect

exercises.explanation: For + a period continuing to now → present perfect.
exercises.explanationPersian: for + مدتی که تا الان ادامه دارد → حال کامل.

exercises.explanation: Yesterday is finished time — use past simple, not present perfect.
exercises.explanationPersian: با yesterday زمان تمام شده است؛ گذشته ساده درست است.

exercises.explanation: Past participle of do is done.
Present perfect needs the past participle: eaten.
exercises.explanationPersian: حال کامل اسم مفعول می‌خواهد: eaten.

exercises.explanation: Never goes between have and the past participle.
exercises.explanationPersian: never بین have و اسم مفعول می‌آید.

exercises.explanation: Since + a starting point (2019); for + a length of time (five years).
exercises.explanationPersian: since + نقطهٔ شروع (2019)؛ for + مدت زمان (five years).

exercises.source: من تا حالا هیچ‌وقت سوشی نخورده‌ام.

commonErrors.feedback: For life experience use present perfect: have never eaten.
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: برای تجربهٔ زندگی از حال کامل استفاده کن: have never eaten.

exercises.prompt: Answer in a full sentence: "Have you ever been to London?" (your answer is no)
acceptedAnswers: No, I have never been to London.
No, I've never been to London.
No, I haven't been to London.
No, I have not been to London.
exercises.explanationPersian: برای تجربهٔ زندگی از حال کامل استفاده می‌کنیم: have never been یا haven't been.

exercises.incorrectSentence: I have lost my keys last night.
acceptedAnswers: I lost my keys last night.
exercises.explanation: With a finished time (last night) use the past simple.
exercises.explanationPersian: با زمان تمام‌شده (last night) از گذشتهٔ ساده استفاده کن.
